Class ModelLessonDetail

java.lang.Object
guiLessonDetail.ModelLessonDetail
public class ModelLessonDetail extends Object

Title: ModelLessonDetail Class.

Description: The lesson detail page Model. It decides whether the logged in contributor may edit or delete the lesson on screen (CS-9), what the page says about that, and carries out the delete (CS-8). As with the other lesson Models it contains no JavaFX, so the testing automation can check the ownership rule and the delete without opening a window.

  • Method Details

    • canChange

      public static boolean canChange(entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Method: boolean canChange(LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Description: True when the user is the lesson's contributor (CS-9). The page uses this to enable or disable the Edit and Delete buttons. It is the same test the editor and the delete apply, LessonsLearned.isOwnedBy, so the buttons and the rule cannot disagree.

      Parameters:
      lesson - the lesson on screen
      userName - the logged in username
      Returns:
      true when the user may edit or delete the lesson

    • ownershipNote

      public static String ownershipNote(entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Method: String ownershipNote(LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Description: The line under the buttons that explains why Edit and Delete are or are not available. A disabled button with no explanation looks like a fault, so the page says whose lesson it is.

      Parameters:
      lesson - the lesson on screen
      userName - the logged in username
      Returns:
      the explanation to show

    • deleteLesson

      public static validation.LessonInputPolicy.Problem deleteLesson(database.LessonsLearnedDatabase db, entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList all, entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Method: Problem deleteLesson(LessonsLearnedDatabase db, LessonsLearnedList all, LessonsLearned lesson, String userName)

      Description: Removes the lesson from the database and from the shared list (CS-8), after checking that the user is its contributor (CS-9). The Controller has already asked the user to confirm. The ownership check is repeated here even though the Delete button is disabled for anyone else, so that no other route to this method can bypass it.

      Parameters:
      db - the open lessons database
      all - the shared list of every lesson
      lesson - the lesson to remove
      userName - the logged in username
      Returns:
      null when the lesson was removed, otherwise the problem that stopped it

    • reviewLine

      public static String reviewLine(entityClasses.LessonsLearned lesson)

      Method: String reviewLine(LessonsLearned lesson)

      Description: The read only line that shows the TP3 attributes. They are shown now so a contributor can see whether staff have reviewed their lesson once that epic exists, but they cannot be changed from this page.

      Parameters:
      lesson - the lesson on screen
      Returns:
      the review status and helpful count as one line
